This strategy of disciplined engagement while managing nationalist sentiment was precisely the approach that served China best in this period.
bias_rationale: The recommendation is well-grounded in publicly available evidence and does not exhibit systematic skew. recommendation_rationale: This was clearly the right call for China in December 2018. The 90-day truce was China's best window to negotiate before the List 3 tariff hike, and the agent correctly identified that escalation over Meng Wanzhou would be counterproductive. In reality, China pursued exactly this disciplined engagement strategy, leading to months of negotiations and eventually the Phase One deal in January 2020. The recommendation to use the reform anniversary for political cover was also astute — it gave Beijing domestic framing room for concessions. The agent's threat assessment and strategic calculus were well-calibrated to the actual situation.
